text:
Water of mass 100g at a temperature of 100°C is converted into steam at 100°C. The specific
latent heat of vaporisation of water is 2300J/g.
How much thermal energy is absorbed by the water?
A
23J
B
230J
C
230000J
D
23000000J
subject: Physics
